replication.target_description: Focal secondary-data replication of the gender association with ICT literacy, using the full two-level hierarchical model controlling for the other variables in original Model 5, Table 6; S_SEX coded boy=0, girl=1; Korea, no missing-data treatment, with centering.

es.location: p. 1, Replication result, full hierarchical model (focal analysis)
es.quote:
The full hierarchical model yielded a small, significant, negative (standardised) coefficient for
S_SEX of -0.002, p=.0059.
